title: Backups
intro: Keep a copy of everything somewhere else, so a broken server doesn't lose your data.
secretKept: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
scheduleOff: No nightly backup. Copies are kept {days} days.
restoreNote: A restore test unpacks the latest copy into a scratch area and compares it. Your live data is not touched.
unavailable: Backups can't be set up from this page on this server yet. Updating Aquarium turns this on.
stateNotConfigured: No offsite copy yet. Your data lives only on this server.
stateNeedsFirstBackup: Storage is ready. Run the first backup.
stateBackupLate: The last good copy is older than two days. Check the storage.
stateNeedsRestoreTest: Copies are being made. Run a restore test to prove they can be opened.
stateOk: Copies are made every night and the last restore test passed.
lastTestNever: Last restore test: not run yet
testedOk: The storage answered and accepted a test file.
phase_encrypting: Locking the copy with your backup key…
phase_checking: Opening it in a scratch area and comparing…
restoreDone: Restore test passed. Nothing live was changed.
keyTitle: Keep this backup key somewhere safe
keyBody: Your copies are locked with this key. If this server is lost, you need it to open them. It is shown only now.
existingKey: Copies are locked with this server's existing backup key.
stopBody: No more copies are sent. Copies already in storage stay there.
needFields: Fill in the bucket name, key ID and secret key.
